findings.label: Pre-existing DISCOVER test assertion fails
findings.detail: tests/card-validator.test.ts:60 asserts detectBrand('6011000000000004') is null, but the validator supports DISCOVER so it returns 'DISCOVER'. The line is untouched by this diff and the behavior predates the refactor; out of scope and non-blocking. Resolve separately by either fixing the assertion or deliberately dropping DISCOVER support.
